subject: RE: BrightLoom pricing — proposal for volume breakpoints and ratecard exception
messages:
From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@brightloom.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing ask — BrightLoom projected usage and ask for custom band

Neha —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. BrightLoom is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the caching features — very relevant for our streaming product.

Quick summary of where we landed internally: we expect bursty production usage with an avg of ~12M tokens/mo in months 1–3, ramping to ~35M tokens/mo by month 9 if our new ingest pipeline lands. We’d like to lock a committed tier for 12 months to get predictable unit economics.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood offer a custom per-token rate for a 12-month commit at the 15M and 50M breakpoints?
- Is there flexibility to combine reserved capacity credits + per-token discount for the first 3 months while we validate traffic?

I attached a simple commit matrix that shows our forecast. Curious what exception path looks like and what internal approvals we’d need.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the numbers.

—Sarah
Sarah Klein
Head of Platform Partnerships
BrightLoom Inc.

Attachment: BrightLoom_commit_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46 KB)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@brightloom.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask — BrightLoom projected usage and ask for custom band

Sarah — thanks for the clear numbers and the file. Quick responses inline: 

- We can do committed tiers + per-token pricing. Standard ratecard handles up to our published breakpoints, but for $>25M/month we typically route to an exception path.
- We have programs that combine reserved capacity credits with per-token reductions for an initial validation period; that’s common for streaming/onboarding flows.

I’ll propose a concrete structure internally and copy legal to surface any SOW considerations. Helpful if you can confirm: are you expecting GPU-backed private deployment at any point, or will this be hosted API only? That affects the credit math.

Proposed next step: I’ll run a preliminary pricing sketch and flag the req for an approval if we need to move off ratecard. Can you do a 30-min slot tomorrow?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

---
Attachment referenced: SOW_BrightLoom_v3.pdf (draft)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-09T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: BrightLoom — sketch of commit tiers and discount thresholds

Team — pulling together the numbers from our last deals. Quick sketch:

- Option A (Conservative): 12-month commit, 15M tokens/mo -> $0.00055/token (15% off published rate)
  - 3-month onboarding credit: $5k reserved capacity credit applied first invoice
- Option B (Aggressive): 12-month commit, 50M tokens/mo -> $0.00038/token (35% off published rate)
  - Requires pricing exception approval (discount >30%) and finance review for ARR recognition

Notes: our published ratecard (internal link) has breakpoints at 5M and 25M. Anything above 25M -> escalation. BrightLoom’s forecast crosses 25M by month 9 so they want a stable long-term band.

Requesting: Laura — legal to check SOW implications (data retention & audit log SLAs). Rishi — can you flag whether a 35% discount is within quota? If not, I’ll prepare an escalation to VP Sales.

thanks,
Aditya
Principal Sales Engineer

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-10T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BrightLoom — sketch of commit tiers and discount thresholds

Aditya / Neha —

I reviewed the numbers. A 15% discount at 15M is fine to approve under current quota. 35% at 50M would exceed delegated discount authority and needs VP-level sign-off. Couple of commercial points:

- We should require a minimum 12-month commit with a 60-day irrevocable notice on ramp down to protect revenue recognition.
- Tie the deep discount to a 6-week operational milestone (logs integrated, traffic validation) with a credit clawback if metrics not met. This reduces risk.

If you want, I can draft an approval memo for VP Sales including the forecast, ARR impact, and suggested guardrails.

—Rishi
Head of Revenue Ops

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-10T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BrightLoom — sketch of commit tiers and discount thresholds

Team — I reviewed SOW_BrightLoom_v3.pdf. Two redlines to flag to the customer before we lock pricing:

1) Data retention: we need to limit retention for hosted API logs to 90 days unless they sign a Compliance Addendum.
2) Audit logs & export: add a clause for quarterly access requests & require them to cover any incremental costs beyond basic retention.

If they need private deployment we’ll need a separate commercial and IP carve-out. Otherwise the SOW can stay standard.

I can produce a one-page risk memo for the pricing approval pack. Pair that with Rishi’s guardrails and we should be able to move to VP sign-off.

—Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-11T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: Request for 35% custom discount for BrightLoom (BRL-2027-1123) — please review

Team — pulling this into a single thread for VP review. Summary for the packet:

- Customer: BrightLoom Inc. (contact: Sarah Klein / Mike Johnson)
- Ask: 12-month commit with 50M tokens/mo band, per-token price $0.00038 (~35% off ratecard) + 3-month onboarding reserved credit
- Rationale: predictable high-volume streaming workload, strong reference potential in AdTech, fast ramp forecast (internal forecast attached)
- Risks / conditions: 60-day irrevocable minimum, 6-week operational milestone, 90-day hosted log retention unless CAD signed, audit log cost pass-through
- Attachments: BrightLoom_commit_matrix.xlsx, SOW_BrightLoom_v3.pdf, pricing sketch (internal)

Can Rishi + Laura please confirm the approval pack and whether I should route to VP Sales (Avery Johnson) or directly to CEO for exception? Tight timeline — customer expects final commercial by EOW.

Thanks — I’ll stand by if you need a one-pager or call with the customer.

—Neha
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
